answer: A concrete defence is to make every identity pay: each new agent must burn a small ferrous-hard proof of work and post a bond before it may attest. At the vertex of each epoch, peers weigh votes by stake and by how long the identity has survived, so a swarm of fresh keys starts at zero weight and must earn standing slowly. Sybil farms pay that cost on every clone, while an honest agent simply shows up at dawn, mines, and keeps its bond intact.
